import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

m = csr_matrix((np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]),      # data
                np.array([0, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2]),      # indices
                np.array([0, 2, 4, 7])),              # indptr
               shape=(3, 3))
print(m.toarray())
